messages:
emma: Quick heads-up: rolling into code freeze for release v2.8.0 in ~3h (cutoff 2026-03-17 22:00 UTC). Only critical bugfixes that meet the 'stability signal' criteria allowed. If you need a late merge exception, fill the form and ping me + @release-bot. Please don't merge any non-trivial refactors.

release-bot: Release freeze scheduled: cutoff 2026-03-17 22:00 UTC. Exception form: https://redwood.internal/late-merge. Eligible types: security, CI-blocking, perf/correctness regressions. Required: impact, rollback plan, test steps.

ben: FYI found a failing e2e in canary that looks like kv-cache NPE when seq > 4096. PR #6789. Is this eligible for exception?

emma: Yes @ben — looks critical. Please open the exception form and paste the PR link + rollback instructions. Tag @carla for quick runtime review. If merged, we'll cherry-pick to `release/v2.8.0-rc` and add a rollback label.

carla: On it. I'll review now. If I sign off, what's the minimal CI surface we need to run to avoid breaking canary? @li any preference?

li: For this class run `./scripts/regress --subset stability` (~20m) and trigger the `deploy-canary` CI job. If both pass, we can consider merge with an approved exception. Also leave a clear rollback snippet: `git revert -m 1 <merge_sha>`.

ben: Opened form: https://redwood.internal/late-merge?pr=6789 — summary: kv-cache NPE in attention cache when seq>4096. Rollback: revert PR 6789 (single-commit). I ran local subset regtests, all green.

emma: :thumbsup: Thanks. @release-bot please tag PR #6789 `exception-pending` and queue the canary run. Also block non-exception merges for the next hour.

release-bot: Tagged PR #6789 as `exception-pending`. Canaries queued (job id:4621). Notifying @tess (release-manager).

tess: Noted. I'll watch job 4621. If it passes by ~21:35 UTC we can cherry-pick and merge before cutoff. If it fails, we hold and prepare rollback plan.

ben: Okay — I'll avoid any other merges to `release/v2.8.0-rc` until we clear this.

emma: Confirmed: freeze in effect. If you see 'stability signal' from me, that means an exception was approved. Thanks all.

carla: Canary passed, job 4621 green. Approving merge. I'll handle the cherry-pick + merge and add rollback tag.

emma: Thank you — proceeding with merge now. Please monitor metrics for the next 30m and flag any anomalies.
